title: Client Experiencing Distress from Biased Interpretations
situation_summary: A client is struggling with emotional distress, such as depression or anxiety, which appears to be driven by a consistent pattern of negatively skewed interpretations of their life events.
presenting_problem: Symptoms of depression, anxiety, or panic disorder, rooted in systematic biases in how the client interprets their experiences.
typical_thoughts_or_feelings: Everything always goes wrong for me
This bad event proves my worst fears

title: Financial Stress and Self-Worth
situation_summary: A client experiences significant distress and self-deprecating thoughts after discovering some checks have bounced.
presenting_problem: Acute depressive feelings and a pervasive sense of personal failure.

title: Chronic Self-Underestimation
situation_summary: A client consistently undervalues their own capabilities and achievements, rooted in a deep-seated belief of personal inadequacy.
presenting_problem: Low self-esteem, difficulty accepting compliments, and a tendency to focus on perceived flaws rather than strengths.
observable_behaviors: hesitation to take on new challenges

title: Client's Fear of Being a Burden in Therapy
situation_summary: A client, after sharing a difficult personal history, expresses anxiety, clarifying that their fear is not of being judged by the therapist, but of being perceived as boring or bothersome.
presenting_problem: Performance anxiety within the therapeutic relationship, fear of negatively impacting the therapist's experience.
typical_thoughts_or_feelings: I'm afraid I will bore you

title: University Student with Depression and Anxiety
situation_summary: An 18-year-old single female in her second semester of university, experiencing significant depression and anxiety for four months, impacting daily activities.
presenting_problem: Moderate depressive episode (meeting DSM-IV-TR criteria) and anxiety, leading to feelings of loneliness and academic struggles.
typical_thoughts_or_feelings: I am a failure, I do nothing right, I will never be happy.
My friends don't want to go out with me.
I'm too tired to go out with them.
If I achieve highly, I am valuable; if I don't achieve highly, I am a failure.
observable_behaviors: Spending a lot of meaningless time in her room
